notes: Gottlieb System 80 Step 17 solenoid test per the Black Hole manual page 13: Self/Test (public 07) and Credit (47) enter Step 16 and a second Self/Test press starts Step 17, which pulses each controlled solenoid while its assigned number appears in the status (ball-in-play) display; Note B says the optional mechanical coin counters are not pulsed.
